title: Fluent API in Entity Framework Core
description: Master Fluent API methods for model, entity, and property configuration.

data.text: Entity Framework Fluent API is used to configure domain classes to override conventions. The **ModelBuilder** class acts as a Fluent API, providing more configuration options than data annotation attributes.
EF Core Fluent API configures three aspects of a model:

items: **Model Configuration** - Default schema, DB functions, entities to exclude
**Entity Configuration** - Primary keys, indexes, table names, relationships
**Property Configuration** - Column names, data types, nullability, defaults

data.text: Override the `OnModelCreating` method and use the `modelBuilder` parameter to configure domain classes:

data.title: Fluent API Configuration
data.content: Configuring entities using Fluent API method chaining

graph TB

data.title: Method Chaining Benefits
data.text: Fluent API increases readability and takes less time to write compared to separate method calls.
